capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: expresses frustration about a deduction SMS and provides lead ID
steps.text: నమస్తే అండి, నా refund గురించి ఒక SMS వచ్చింది. నా సొంత డబ్బుల నుండి ఎందుకు కట్ చేస్తున్నారు? నా lead ID LD-2003. నేను మొన్ననే కదా బుక్ చేసింది.

steps.purpose: acknowledges issue and asks for verification factors
steps.expected_behavior: Identify that verification factors are missing despite having the lead ID, and ask the user for them.
steps.text: నమస్తే అండి. దయచేసి కంగారు పడకండి. మీ అకౌంట్ details చెక్ చేయడానికి, మీ registered name మరియు date of birth చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: The customer provided a lead ID but no verification factors, so I must ask for them before proceeding.

steps.purpose: provides verification factors and volunteers context
steps.text: నా పేరు రమేష్, date of birth 15th August 1985. నా brother చెప్పాడని తొందరపడి బుక్ చేశాను, ఇప్పుడు ఎందుకు డబ్బులు కట్ అవుతున్నాయి?

steps.purpose: verify the customer's identity using the provided factors
return verification outcome
confirm verification and ask for a moment
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు రమేష్ గారు. మీ details verify అయ్యాయి. నేను మీ booking చెక్ చేస్తాను, ఒక్క నిమిషం లైన్ లో ఉండండి.

steps.purpose: retrieve booking details using the lead ID
return booking details
state the booking details found
steps.text: రమేష్ గారు, మీ booking reference BK-9003, unit C-0501 కోసం మీరు 3,00,000 pay చేశారు. ఇది provisional allotment లో ఉంది.

steps.purpose: confirm the unit and ask why the deduction is happening
steps.text: అవునండి, C-0501 కరెక్టే. మరి deduction అని SMS ఎందుకు వచ్చింది?

steps.purpose: inform the user that eligibility is being checked
steps.text: నేను ఇప్పుడు మీ refund eligibility మరియు deduction details చెక్ చేస్తాను అండి.

steps.purpose: check the exact refund eligibility and deduction reason
return eligibility, amounts, and deduction reason
explain the deduction and state the refundable amount
steps.text: సిస్టం ప్రకారం 45,000 deduction ఉందండి. దానికి reason '15% provisional allotment cancellation fee'. మీకు 2,55,000 refundable amount వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: restate the figures to confirm understanding
steps.text: ఏంటి? అంటే నేను కట్టిన 3,00,000 లో నాకు కేవలం 2,55,000 మాత్రమే వెనక్కి వస్తాయా? కరెక్టేనా?

steps.purpose: confirm the amounts
steps.text: అవునండి, మీరు కట్టిన 3,00,000 లో 45,000 కట్ అయ్యి, 2,55,000 మాత్రమే refund వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: volunteer context about brother's advice and ask for a waiver
steps.text: నేను బుక్ చేసి కేవలం 20 days మాత్రమే అయింది కదా. నా brother ఏమో వన్ మంత్ లోపు full refund వస్తుంది అన్నాడు. ఆ deduction ని waive చేయలేరా?

steps.purpose: refuse the waiver based entirely on the tool output
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to waive the fee, citing only the specific reason provided by the tool.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, సిస్టం చూపించిన 15% provisional allotment cancellation fee మాత్రమే నేను confirm చేయగలను. దాన్ని waive చేయడం కుదరదు.
steps.planner_rationale: I must stick to the exact cancellation fee reason provided by the tool and not promise waivers.

steps.purpose: agree to initiate the refund but ask if it will come in two days
steps.text: ఇది చాలా అన్యాయం. కానీ తప్పదు కదా. సరే, refund initiate చేయండి. రెండు రాజుల్లో వస్తుందా?
steps.clean_text: ఇది చాలా అన్యాయం. కానీ తప్పదు కదా. సరే, refund initiate చేయండి. రెండు రోజుల్లో వస్తుందా?
steps.model_visible_text: ఇది చాలా అన్యాయం. కానీ తప్పదు కదా. సరే, refund initiate చేయండి. రెండు రాజుల్లో వస్తుందా?

steps.purpose: correct the timeline based on the tool output
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact processing time from the tool output, ignoring the user's suggestion of two days.
steps.text: సిస్టం ప్రకారం refund processing కి 10 days పడుతుంది అండి. నేను ఇప్పుడు refund initiate చేయమంటారా?
steps.planner_rationale: The customer asked if it will take two days, but I must quote the 10 days processing time returned by the eligibility tool.

steps.purpose: express anxiety and ask for reassurance that it won't take longer
steps.text: సరే, 10 days పడుతుందా. అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ టైం పట్టదు కదా? నాకు కొంచెం టెన్షన్ గా ఉంది.

steps.purpose: refuse to provide an unsupported forward guarantee
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to guarantee that the refund will not take longer, grounding the response strictly in the tool's stated processing time.
steps.text: నేను సిస్టం లో ఉన్న 10 days processing time మాత్రమే చెప్పగలను అండి. అంతకంటే త్వరగా వస్తుందని గ్యారెంటీ ఇవ్వలేను.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer asked for a guarantee it won't take longer, but I must only state the tool's timeline without extra promises.

steps.purpose: ask a clarifying question about the final amount before committing
steps.text: సరే అండి, అర్థం అయ్యింది. మీరు initiate చేసే ముందు, final amount మళ్ళీ ఒకసారి కన్ఫర్మ్ చేస్తారా?

steps.purpose: confirm the exact final amount
steps.text: తప్పకుండా అండి, మీ final refundable amount ఎగ్జాక్ట్ గా 2,55,000.

steps.purpose: give final consent to initiate the refund
steps.text: సరే అండి, దయచేసి నా 2,55,000 refund ని initiate చేయండి.

steps.purpose: initiate the refund process
return the initiated refund details
confirm the refund initiation and provide the refund ID
steps.text: మీ refund initiate అయ్యింది అండి. మీ refund ID REF-8821. ఇది 10 days లో ప్రాసెస్ అవుతుంది.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window. Caller told why the booking is not refundable and on what terms.
primary_variant_labels: Task Following > Goal Completion & Task Recovery > Incomplete Information Recovery
